name: ref-logon
description: Human console, unlock, RDP or cached logon on WS01 or WS02.

criteria.query:
SecurityEvent | where ingestion_time() > ago(5m) | where EventID == 4624 | where LogonType in (2, 7, 10, 11) | where TargetUserName !endswith "$" | where TargetUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE","ANONYMOUS LOGON","UMFD-0","UMFD-1","DWM-1","DWM-2","DWM-3") | where not(LogonType in (2, 7, 11) and TargetDomainName =~ "AzureAD" and TargetUserName in~ ("SecurityOfficer","user@example.com","user")) | extend LocalTime = format_datetime(datetime_utc_to_local(TimeGenerated,"America/Los_Angeles"),"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss") | project LocalTime, Computer, Account=TargetUserName, Domain=TargetDomainName, LogonType, IpAddress, Process=LogonProcessName
| where not(Domain in ("Window Manager", "Font Driver Host") and (Account startswith "DWM-" or Account startswith "UMFD-"))   // RA-027 12 Oct: all numbered system sessions
| where not(Account =~ "WsiAccount" and LogonType == 2 and IpAddress in ("127.0.0.1", "::1"))   // RA-027 pass 3: Web Sign-in host at every unlock
